summary: Build a more lively, graphics-heavy homepage with an immersive 'traveling through a tool shed' theme.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Tool shed interior corridor/aisle scene with warm workshop lighting, inviting perspective (toolshed-journey-hero.dim_1600x900.png)
- Set of workshop/tool-shed themed decorative UI stickers (e.g., labels, tags, caution stripes, bolts) on transparent background (toolshed-ui-stickers.dim_1400x900.png)
- Wood plank texture background, subtle and tileable (toolshed-wood-texture.dim_1024x1024.png)
- Workbench scene flat-lay banner with tools and materials (workbench-banner.dim_1600x600.png)

## Edit Images
- Shift the existing hero image to match a more immersive tool shed travel vibe (toolshare-hero.dim_1600x900.png > toolshare-hero-toolshed.dim_1600x900.png)

existing_features.title: Redesign the homepage (frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx) to feel like an immersive journey “traveling through a tool shed,” using a more life-filled, graphics-heavy layout while preserving the existing primary actions (Browse Tools, Get Started / List a Tool) and authentication-dependent behavior.

Implement a cohesive visual theme for the new homepage that reinforces the tool-shed travel vibe (e.g., warm workshop lighting, wood/metal textures, signage/labels), and apply it consistently across the homepage sections without changing the global app layout (header/footer) behavior.

Add lightweight, performant visual motion to support the “travel” feeling on the homepage (e.g., parallax-like section transitions, subtle animated floating dust motes/light beams, or animated sign/indicator elements) using CSS/Tailwind-friendly techniques and respecting reduced-motion preferences.
Integrate newly generated static image assets for the homepage into the app by placing them under frontend/public/assets/generated and referencing them from the homepage implementation.

new_feature_requests.summary: Design and implement a more life-filled homepage with additional graphics/visuals and an immersive 'traveling through a tool shed' experience.

projectName: Redesign homepage with immersive, graphics-heavy 'traveling through a tool shed' experience
